| If you just forfeited a character of ability < 5 present at a site, deploy on that character (who remains at same site). Character is forfeit = 0 (even if forfeit may not normally be reduced). == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Field Dressing]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column.
